game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Pumice Pass Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before molten golems spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before molten golems spring the trap. Each round, a new sulfur crystals challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 380 points of sulfur crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 380 within 51 seconds.
